'''Ana Vitorrian''' was an [[Lawyer/Legends|attorney]] working for the [[Black Bha'lir]]. Raised in high society, Vitorrian attended the best schools, including the [[Imperial Academy/Legends|Imperial Academy]]. After serving as a legal assistant to the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]], she opened her own law practice which specialized in prosecuting "enemies" of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. After falling into an on-off relationship with the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Thaddeus Ross]], Vitorrian's views came to support the working man, even if those individuals broke the law to survive. Over time, Vitorrian was recruited by the Black Bha'lir to be their head defense attorney.<ref name="BSS" />
